changes: Raise the response-body ceiling from 170,000,000 to 260,000,000 bytes for acquisition of the same 159,164,372-byte archive.
Retrieve the archive in 4 MiB ranges instead of 8 MiB ranges, retaining the same byte count, official SHA-256, central-directory SHA-256, candidate set, parser, metrics, thresholds, and stop rules.

Use the 2021-05-07 Internet Archive Memento of the exact NIST URL only if the completed bytes match the current NIST manifest's length and SHA-256. The Memento is a transport mirror, not an evidentiary substitute.
reason: On 2026-08-22 the NIST origin returned HTTP 524 for both a full request and the first 8 MiB range, including a separate checksum-sidecar probe. The Memento returned the correct 159,164,372-byte Content-Length and accepted ranges, but closed long-lived 8 MiB transfers after roughly 5 MiB. Five complete ranges and incomplete retries consumed transport bytes without exposing or inflating any ZIP member. A 4 MiB range stays below the observed connection boundary; the larger ceiling accounts conservatively for already transferred failed fragments while remaining far below any MPM image archive.
inspectedBeforeAmendment: HTTP status, response headers, range progress, official archive size and SHA-256, and the already sealed 2021 central-directory identity.
The local partial file only as a byte count for safe resumption; no ZIP local header, compressed member, CSV row, candidate feature, rank, or eligibility result was read.
notChanged: L0001 target and L0002-L0025 candidate roles
all nine hard eligibility gates and composite ranking score
prohibition on AVI, TIFF, layer-image, and L0001 pixel acquisition
budgetAccountingBoundary: Failed connections did not expose candidate content but their received body fragments count against the amended 260 MB ceiling. The acquisition receipt reports the fetcher's conservative charged count; prior NIST requests returned zero body bytes.
scientificEffect: None. This is a transport-only amendment made before any outcome-bearing member data were inspected.
